thread:
olivia_sre: Quick sanity check — we're switching ETL DB and the archived object buckets to 'customer-managed' keys this afternoon. Planning RBAC tighten + kv-lock on backup access. Any known gotchas?

matt_infra: Do we have a validated grant workflow for the backup uploader service account?

sara_security: Not yet. I think last audit showed the uploader used a long-lived key grant. Need ephemeral grants with explicit IAM condition.

yash_eng: I'll run the dry-run decryption test against last week's snapshot in staging. Can someone confirm the rotation window?

jess_oncall: heads-up — oncall shift starts in 45m, please tag me if you want immediate rollback support. :+1:

olivia_sre: good catch, @jess_oncall. If decryption fails in staging we stop the rollout. Also want to enable more verbose audit logging on uploads.

encops-bot: Ticket #ENC-2147 created: "CMK switch for etl-db + buckets — grant hardening + audit logs" assigned to @matt_infra and @sara_security. ETA 4h.

matt_infra: For the uploader, propose this policy change (snippet):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234",
  "Condition": {"ForAnyValue:StringEquals": {"kms:GrantName": "upload-temp"}}
}
```

yash_eng: That Condition won't work for older grants. We should create a short-lived grant via the API at start-of-job and revoke after upload. I can add that to the uploader code.

sara_security: Also add an audit marker: uploader should write a tiny manifest file to the bucket with SHA+key-id so we can cross-check decrypt attempts in CloudTrail.

olivia_sre: manifest idea is great. Let's also add a periodic canary restore job that decrypts a subset of backups using the new CMK/gateway path.

jess_oncall: Agree, schedule a canary during low traffic window. I'll own the runbook if anything fails.

matt_infra: Quick question — if we flip CMK for the DB snapshots, will the DB service still be able to create snapshots during the rotation window? Need to ensure no implicit-deny when grants expire.

sara_security: We'll create transition grants: old-key -> temporary dual-grant window for 30m so snapshots created right around the switch are covered. Ops must monitor CloudWatch KMSErrorCount metric.

yash_eng: I'm kicking off the staging decrypt now. Sharing output: 
```
>> restore-test --snapshot=etl-stg-2026-03-20
Decrypt succeeded using key-id: abcd-1234
Manifest SHA matches: true
```

olivia_sre: Nice. That means uploader + grants + manifest all work in staging. Next: a quick RBAC audit to ensure no broad principals have `kms:Decrypt` on the new CMK.

matt_infra: On that audit: I found one legacy role `etl-legacy-runner` with `kms:*` on the account. Propose we replace with a scoped role and remove wildcard.

sara_security: Strong yes. Assign the role removal to me, but we need migration steps: add new scoped role, update any cron jobs, then remove wildcard.

encops-bot: Reminder: backup retention audit policy will log any manifest mismatch as HIGH severity alert.

jess_oncall: If we see a manifest mismatch during canary, immediate rollback and open incident channel. I'll page infra and sec.

olivia_sre: One more edge: object lifecycle jobs that rehydrate archives — they also read backups. Make sure they call the grant creation API, otherwise they'll fail post-rollout. @yash_eng can you grep for `kms:Decrypt` usages in repo?

yash_eng: On it. Found two rehydration jobs under `archiver/service` — will PR to add ephemeral grant flow.

matt_infra: After code changes, we'll run a full end-to-end: create temp grant -> upload -> manifest -> archived -> restore (canary) -> revoke grant. If all green, proceed to prod flip.

sara_security: Also adding CloudTrail filter: eventName in [Encrypt, Decrypt, CreateGrant, RetireGrant] for that CMK to a dedicated S3 bucket with 90d retention.

olivia_sre: timeline: complete code PRs in 2h, run staging canary in 3h, if green we start prod rollout in maintenance window tonight.

jess_oncall: I'll be available for the window. Will prepare pager rotation just in case.

yash_eng: PR linked: https://git.company/archiver/merge/92 — includes grant create/revoke and manifest write.

matt_infra: I'll provision the CMK alias `alias/etl-cmk-prod` and pre-create the transition grants for the window.

sara_security: After rollout, schedule a postmortem checklist: RBAC diff, CloudTrail sample, canary logs, and a review of any failed decrypts.

olivia_sre: Thanks team. If anyone spots anything else, drop it here. Otherwise we'll proceed with the plan in 3h. :rocket:
